digest.component_or_area: plan review tag matcher and close-gate semantics
propositions: The canonical tag regex must accept both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] spellings case-insensitively without underscore variants
A single regex pattern change must propagate uniformly to five consumers: four with normal match semantics and one with inverted semantics in the close-gate
The inverted-semantics consumer in txn.py:547 must exempt unchecked AC items tagged [non-codebase] from the close block, identical to [operator-attested] behavior
The regex alternation must be non-capturing to preserve list[str] return type in operator_attested_ac_texts rather than breaking into tuples via findall()
The criteria_routing.json activation trigger must match descriptions tagged with either spelling to fire measurement-provenance routing
ADR-0101 must define [non-codebase] semantics and document [operator-attested] as an undocumented alias before this regex accepts it
